query: WITH yearly_umrah AS (SELECT YEAR(entry_timestamp) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(CAST(id AS STRING), '-', CAST(dependent_seq_no AS STRING))) AS umrah_count FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala WHERE TRIM(visa_type_description) = 'عمرة' AND NOT entry_timestamp IS NULL AND YEAR(entry_timestamp) BETWEEN 2006 AND 2025 AND trip_duration_days >= 0 GROUP BY YEAR(entry_timestamp)), growth_calc AS (SELECT year, umrah_count, LAG(umrah_count) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS prev_year_count FROM yearly_umrah) SELECT year, umrah_count, ROUND((umrah_count - prev_year_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev_year_count, 0), 2) AS growth_rate_pct FROM growth_calc ORDER BY year LIMIT 1200
